entries.text_en: Launched in 2006 as part of Amazon Prime’s membership perks, Amazon Prime Video has grown into one of the world’s leading streaming platforms, competing head-to-head with Netflix and Disney+. Initially designed to offer free shipping and exclusive deals to Amazon’s loyal customers, Prime Video expanded its service to include a vast library of original content, licensed films, and live sports. The platform gained significant traction with its 2013 entry into original programming, producing acclaimed series like *The Marvelous Mrs. Maisel* and *The Boys*, which have won multiple awards and attracted a global audience. Prime Video also stands out for its hybrid model, offering both subscription-based streaming and pay-per-view options for rentals or purchases, catering to diverse viewing preferences. Its integration with Amazon’s ecosystem, including voice control via Alexa and seamless cross-device streaming, further enhances user convenience. As of 2024, Prime Video boasts over 200 million subscribers worldwide, solidifying its position as a dominant force in the OTT (over-the-top) streaming industry, though it has faced criticism for price hikes and content exclusivity disputes, particularly in markets like the UK where Prime membership fees surged by 61% in 2024 without prior negotiation options for users.
